purpose: Deterministic, use-scoped source admissibility. Answers admissible(source, qualification, evidence_context) with a reason. Source category ALONE never grants admissibility.

evidence_roles.primary_authoritative: Strongest source for the specific question (e.g. dictionary for lexical existence; customs data for recorded imports).
evidence_roles.corroborating: Independent support that strengthens but does not alone establish.
evidence_roles.contextual: Explains/frames; never establishes a sovereign/official/scientific fact alone.
evidence_roles.historical: Establishes a past state, explicitly time-bounded.

newly_ratified.note: The governing statute/regulation/directive/standard/treaty itself; REQUIRED for current-law claims.
Official technical standard (e.g. DIN/ISO) as issued.

Authority for a customs/statistical goods NOMENCLATURE (WCO Harmonized System and its official government/intergovernmental reproductions, e.g. UN Comtrade HS reference, national customs tariffs). Added (source-qualification correction / classification-resolution) because neither 'official_standard' (technical standards like DIN/ISO) nor 'intergovernmental_trade_database' (trade FLOW data) correctly names a classification nomenclature authority. Establishes classification identity ONLY, never trade totals or scientific/market claims.

evaluated_not_ratified_yet.reason: No system need yet; revisit when environment domain activates.
Revisit only with biomedical program + high claim restriction.
Distinct evidentiary role unclear for current scope.
Overlaps official_standard; avoid duplicate taxonomy until distinct need shown.

ratified_source_categories.note: Newly-ratified categories are ADDED TO POLICY VOCABULARY only. They are NOT written into source_registry.json approved categories and NO source uses them yet. Admission of a real source under any of these awaits a later Source Qualification acquisition sprint.

customs_classification.note: A goods-classification IDENTITY (an HS heading/subheading code and its official label, or a national tariff code) is established by ONE authoritative nomenclature authority — the nomenclature is definitional, not a contested empirical measurement — so the pattern is single_authoritative_sufficient (unlike trade_economics totals, which stay primary_plus_corroborating). This domain establishes classification identity/boundaries ONLY: never trade totals, never a chemical/scientific property, never current law. A trade-flow source (official_trade_statistics) is NOT in allowed_categories here: recording imports of a labelled product does not make a source an authority for the classification nomenclature itself.

evidence_sufficiency_patterns.single_authoritative_sufficient: One primary-authoritative source establishes the fact (e.g. dictionary entry -> lexical existence).
evidence_sufficiency_patterns.primary_plus_corroborating: One primary/official source plus >=1 independent corroborating record.
evidence_sufficiency_patterns.multi_source_synthesis: Several independent evidence records for a complex analytical claim.
evidence_sufficiency_patterns.original_instrument_required: The governing instrument itself is required (current legal/regulatory status).
evidence_sufficiency_patterns.explicit_source_exclusion: A named category is forbidden for a particular claim regardless of other support.

layer_independence: admissible(...) answers ONLY 'may this evidence be admitted?'. It never returns claim approval, claim-registry activation, route publication, or indexation — those are separate, later, independent decisions.
